rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 credit from accredited providers; ACOG formal cognates and AAFP prescribed credits accepted as equivalent. Residency participation or ABMS/AOA board certification/recertification in the period = 50 hours; up to 10 hours/year for board, health committee or peer review service
rules.new_licensee_rule: A first license issued for less than 24 months (to align with birth month) needs pro-rated hours.
rules.carryover: Up to 20 hours of category 1 credit may be carried into the next license period.
rules.alternatives: Exempt for active military duty, practice only in another state that has CE rules (and no care to Iowa patients), government work abroad; extension/exemption up to one year for disability or illness.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation (dates, subjects, duration, proof). The board may audit at any time; respond within 30 days.

topics.who: Physicians who regularly provide primary care to children (emergency, family, general practice, pediatrics, psychiatry, others); HHS-approved training every 3 years

Dependent adult abuse identification and reporting; physicians who regularly provide primary care to adults (emergency, family, general practice, internal medicine, OB/GYN, psychiatry, others); every 3 years
Licensees who prescribed opioids in the prior license period; Category 1 on CDC opioid prescribing guidelines (chronic pain management), every 5 years
Licensees who regularly provide direct care to actively dying patients; Category 1, every 5 years

rules.notes: One board for MDs and DOs. Permanent licenses renew biennially by birth month; special licenses annually with 20 hours. Board website returned 403 to us; data from the Iowa Administrative Code.
